title: Boron trifluoride in three dimensions
hook: Turn a model of BF₃ and examine its shape.

knows: Atoms or cells can be represented with simplified models.
doesNotKnow: Three bonding regions surround boron. They lie in a plane in the ideal trigonal planar model.
